property_summary: For any input _val, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract stores MinSum equal to the provided _val; the mutant that assigns MinSum = _val; MinSum = _val + 1 violates this by storing a different value for some _val (specifically when _val+1 != _val, i.e., any _val where overflow doesn't wrap to same value).
change_summary: Add a double-assignment so MinSum is set twice (first to _val, then to _val+1), changing final stored value.
